# The mutations this app's log carries. Generated by `--write`; checked on every
# build. A verb or an argument may be ADDED — a payload without a field decodes
# to that field's default. Removing or renaming a verb, or dropping or retyping
# an argument, breaks every entry already written, and the check refuses it.
AddSong title:Text artist:Text album:Text duration_ms:Integer file:Text track:Integer part:Text catalogue:Text performer:Text bpm:Integer album_art:Text artist_art:Text disc:Integer work_title:Text movement_no:Integer
RemoveMedia id:Id(media)
DescribeWork id:Text opus:Text key_sig:Text form:Text period:Text composed:Integer art:Text
AddToPlaylist playlist_id:Id(playlist) media_id:Id(media)
CreatePlaylist name:Text
DescribePerson name:Text sort_name:Text born:Integer died:Integer art:Text
CreditRecording recording_id:Text person_name:Text role:Text instrument:Text pos:Integer
DescribeRecording id:Text recorded:Integer venue:Text label:Text licence:Text art:Text
AddAllToPlaylist playlist_id:Id(playlist)
RemoveFromPlaylist playlist_id:Id(playlist) media_id:Id(media)
